baseline_rules.bottleneck_balanced: Start empty; evaluate every feasible singleton addition using original resource_lp. Key is (global bound, descending four target serial-service times). Accept strict lexicographic key improvement, including zero global gain. Choose minimum (key, candidate id); repeat until no improvement. No deletion, swaps, bundles or oracle lookahead.
baseline_rules.joint: Unmodified multi_joint.joint_scenarios; original MILP then original resource_lp routing and byte rounding. No secondary objective or modified solver.
baseline_rules.local_capacity_fill: Visit candidates by (tp, off, id); add each if original layout_ledger accepts it. All candidates are target-local; no marginal scoring.
baseline_rules.strong_simple: Unmodified frozen_layout.strong_simple; report all three controls and common resource_lp final score.

c1_c2_control: Same candidate identities/content/placement opportunities and budgets, target/source worker IDs, path rates and capacities. Only source4/5 independent export ResourceIDs become one U. Raw node-derived DRAM names change, stable DRAM roles remain independent.

budget_ledger.runtime_unknown_reason: Worker runtime must be independently admitted under unchanged 2GiB/node historical budget; symbolic eight workers are not deployable evidence
budget_ledger.scope: Externally prescribed cache budget only; no physical allocation or deployment authorization
budget_ledger.staging_status: Known conservative execution reservation: 64MiB per logical worker, 512MiB total; unallocated and not physically admitted

decision_boundary.candidate_opportunity: All eight target-local block candidates, including those excluded by zero location capacity; no remote-HBM placement candidate in this phase
decision_boundary.fallback: Full immutable per-rank DRAM base at source rank+4, always available
decision_boundary.routing: Original resource_lp, rank_interleaved queue; direct unicast only
decision_boundary.scope: Capacity and bottleneck-baseline contract only; not general remote-placement assignment or proof of complex joint benefit

path_contract.incidence_semantics: Each byte consumes every listed resource once; equal ResourceID means one shared constraint, never additive capacities.

metric_contract.model_binding_and_verification_time: unknown; record separately before real experiment
metric_contract.prediction_fields: resource bound, isolated worker-order symbolic score; neither is measured T_ready
metric_contract.primary_real_metric: controller weight-load-start to all target ranks filled/usable

normalized_time_semantics: Dimensionless theoretical service unit; fields emitted by reused planners as seconds are not physical seconds. Rates are 4MiB/unit normalized coefficients only.
stopping_conditions: Same real layout/routes after calibration: stop duplicate GPU policy comparison
Strong simple/balanced baseline has same cost: report no joint decision gain; do not add favorable parameters
Unknown physical shared path or capacity: keep physical readiness false
Eight logical workers exceed original 2GiB/node runtime allowance: do not deploy or increase budget
CPU fixture/schema failure: preserve failed run and diagnose fixed input before retry
No authorized GPU/SSH run in this contract; any physical execution needs parent-managed admission
unknowns: physical role mapping under unchanged budget
